document: Azure Functions is a serverless compute service that lets you run event-triggered code without managing infrastructure. Durable Functions extends it with stateful workflows: orchestrator functions coordinate execution deterministically, activity functions do the actual work, and entities hold state. Azure OpenAI Service provides enterprise-grade access to OpenAI's models with the networking, compliance, and regional availability options large organizations need. Azure AI Search adds vector and hybrid retrieval over your own content, commonly used to ground LLM responses in facts. Azure Logic Apps offers a low-code way to build workflows that call hundreds of connectors, including a native Azure OpenAI connector, without writing orchestration code by hand. Azure Service Bus and Event Grid provide two different messaging models -- reliable queued delivery and lightweight pub-sub eventing respectively -- that are the backbone of decentralized, multi-agent architectures. Together these services let you build every one of the nine agentic AI design patterns entirely on managed Azure PaaS, without operating your own servers, message brokers, or vector databases.
